AfterPlayerTurnStart.issue: SLOT. AfterPlayerTurnStart is a POST-draw hook -- hook_dispatch step 27 lists Hook.AfterPlayerTurnStart (882-908) among the multi-pass dispatchers and it runs after SetupPlayerTurn -- but the sim uses on_player_turn_start, which is pre-draw. The sim's on_player_turn_start (player.py:169) fires BEFORE the hand draw (player.py:171-186); C#'s side-turn-start dispatchers run at CombatManager.cs:458 (Before) and :522 (After), i.e. either side of SetupPlayerTurn at :514. EXECUTED: a spy records [on_player_turn_start hand=5, 4x on_card_drawn, on_player_turn_started hand=9]. Third-file citations, not hashed here. Live consequence: Crimson Mantle deals self-damage and then gains block at turn start, and the sim does both BEFORE the hand is drawn. A lethal self-damage tick therefore cancels a hand draw the game has already made, which is conformance-visible even when nothing dies because the draw consumes rng; and Hellraiser's draw-triggered auto-plays (powers.py:707-713) see the block in the sim and not in the game. The sim also has the correct slot available and unused: on_player_turn_started (player.py:186), which is where the phase-aware relics live.
